# Denis Ibañez

> AI Engineer and front-end architect building AI-native products and agentic workflows — 14+ years shaping high-traffic UIs in Vue, React and Angular. Based in Portugal, working with distributed teams across Spain, the UK, the Netherlands and Germany. AI-Empowered SAFe® Practitioner (SP).

## Pages

- [About](https://denisibanez.dev/about): Background, tech stack, certifications, and a short FAQ about how he works.
- [Projects](https://denisibanez.dev/projects): Selected case studies and self-driven studies in Vue, React, React Native and Angular.
- [Blog](https://denisibanez.dev/blog): Essays on design systems, front-end craft, AI-assisted engineering and agentic workflows.
- [Testimonials](https://denisibanez.dev/testimonials): Feedback from clients and collaborators.
- [Connect](https://denisibanez.dev/connect): Setup instructions for connecting an AI client to the MCP server below.

## For AI agents

An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server is available at https://denisibanez.dev/api/mcp
(Streamable HTTP, no authentication) exposing structured, localized tools: get_profile,
get_projects, get_project, get_blog_posts, get_blog_post, get_testimonials, get_faq, and
contact_denis (sends a message directly to Denis). See /connect for client setup steps.
